scope.target: A tag-triggered release that requires no post-tag source commit and completes provider reconciliation automatically.
constraints: The user owns tag creation and timing.
Provider reconciliation must be idempotent and source-read-only.

steps: Normalize v0.10+ online Issue reference validation.
Make the tagged pre-publication record terminal for source.
Add provider preflight and idempotent reconciliation.
Rewrite policy/runbook/templates and add failure fixtures.
execution.last_completed_step: Implemented terminal validated source state, v0.10+ online Issue routing, protected tag-only provider preflight, idempotent post-publication reconciliation, and historical-only closeout guidance.
execution.next_action: Integrate the validated implementation through the owning pull request.

results.summary: Changed the normal v0.12+ release lifecycle so validated source is terminal: the owner tag triggers archive publication, hosted verification, Published-in updates, and #169 closure with no post-tag source commit.
results.residual_risk: Tag automation requires the separately managed RELEASE_PROVIDER_TOKEN. It is withheld from pull-request workflows and injected only into exact privileged tag steps; a missing or unusable token fails before Release mutation.
